# madmom attribution and model-data license

Parts of mir-core preserve or reproduce behavior from the madmom source
implementation. The packaged `mir_core/checkpoints/bocktcn/*.pkl` files are
madmom model/data assets and remain separate from the native code ports.

Source: <https://github.com/CPJKU/madmom>
